risks.summary: Demucs runtime depends on PyTorch/torchaudio-style stacks that require worker isolation and dependency/security review.
Official docs mention CPU fallback and GPU memory segment controls; production quality/cost would need bounded worker policy.
Input/output audio formats and ffmpeg behavior must remain private-worker-only and reviewed for codec/patent/configuration exposure.
Source separation outputs can expose vocals/stems from private user or controlled media and require strict private artifact policy.
Broad stem separation over user media may implicate music rights and is blocked for beta/production.
